This gym is a complete disappointment. The machines are poorly maintained, with no proper equipment like plates or a deadlift platform. The staff’s communication is unprofessional and rude. Worst of all, the machine handles are so dirty that the color sticks to your hands after use—absolutely unhygienic! I’m fed up with the lack of care and basic facilities. Management needs to take immediate action to fix these issues or risk losing more customers. Do better!

The state of the equipment is abysmal. A significant number of machines are either broken, squeaking ominously, or missing critical components like weight plates and adjustment pins. For example, I’ve encountered multiple occasions where I couldn’t complete a workout because the necessary weights simply weren’t available—either lost, misplaced, or never replaced. This isn’t just an inconvenience; it derails entire fitness plans and makes the membership feel like a waste of money. A gym’s core offering is its equipment, and failing to maintain it shows a blatant disregard for customers’ needs. Management must prioritize regular inspections, repairs, and restocking to restore functionality.The absence of a deadlift platform is a glaring oversight for any gym claiming to cater to serious fitness enthusiast.gym of this caliber should have invested in a dedicated space with appropriate flooring and equipment long ago. It’s a basic standard that’s been ignored, and it alienates anyone serious about their training.

I’m beyond frustrated with this gym. It’s evident that management has let standards slide to an unacceptable degree, prioritizing cost-cutting (or sheer apathy) over the well-being of its members. The issues I’ve outlined—faulty equipment, missing facilities, filthy conditions, and rude staff—aren’t minor inconveniences; they’re dealbreakers that make this place feel like a scam. I urge management to take immediate action: repair and maintain the machines, install a deadlift platform, overhaul the cleaning regimen, and retrain the staff to treat customers with respect. Without these changes, this gym will continue to hemorrhage members and tarnish its reputation further. Do better—your customers deserve it, and so does your business.

I paid ₹22,000 in January because I was promised a new upgraded full package gym with facilities like a steam, ice bath etc. However, the new setup was not ready for months, I assume it started around mid year if I’m not mistaken and I couldn’t join at that time, so I finally joined in September.

At the time of joining, I was clearly told that my membership would be counted from September, not January. Based on that understanding, I even brought two of my friends to join the gym and was recommending it to others as well.

But in February, I was suddenly told that as per their “policy,” I should have started within one month of payment, and now I need to pay ₹18,000 again for renewal. This was never communicated earlier and directly contradicts what I was told when I joined.

I understand policies and rules. But don’t over promise or give fake promises, I hadn’t even properly started using the gym, yet I was being asked to pay again (18k more) after paying (22k) mind you the maintenance is bad, wasn’t aware of the activities… Zumba started after weeks of I joined.. barely other activities… wasn’t even aware of Ice bath… sauna hasn’t yet started there is no cafeteria no massage room all gimmicks and extensive marketing.

Overall,  felt very unfair and misleading. I trusted what was told to me at the time of
joining, but later the terms were changed without any consideration.

Would not recommend based on my experience.

featured_reviews.name: Bhavik Doshi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I joined AISW one year ago.

On my very first day, I met a trainer who was calm, composed, and deeply confident in what he knew. He understood exactly what I needed, even before I could explain it properly myself. I signed up with him as my personal trainer immediately.

That trainer was Veeraj Sir.

Before we even started training seriously, he tested my body strength, stamina, mobility, and muscle capacity. There was never any rush. His philosophy was simple: progress slowly, but correctly. Every workout had purpose. Warm-ups and stretches were just as important to him as lifting weights.

And somehow, through an entire year of training, I never dealt with the kind of post-workout pain or injuries people usually talk about.

When I joined, I was overweight. Honestly, I still am… just a few kilos less now 😄
But I’ve already lost 15 kgs.

Today, I can box squat 70 kgs without pain. My chest, biceps, core, stamina, and overall strength are in a much better place.

But the biggest transformation was not physical.

My daily medicines reduced from 7 to just 2.
My blood pressure medicines disappeared.
No diabetes medication anymore.
Even my doctor asked me to stop taking multivitamins.

I feel energetic again.
I’m playing the best cricket of my life.
And most importantly…
I ended my long, exhausting relationship with back pain.

That alone changed my quality of life.

Veeraj Sir didn’t just help me lose weight. He helped me regain confidence in my own body again.

One year later, I can genuinely say that one of the things that impressed me most about him is his deep understanding of the science of the human body. The way he explains muscle function, recovery, movement, posture, and overall physiology makes you realize that his training is not random — every exercise has a scientific reason behind it. He understands how the body works and adapts, and that knowledge reflects in the safe, effective, and sustainable progress his clients make.

Now I’m looking forward to another year under his guidance. This next year feels less about fitness and more about transformation.

And honestly, the biggest compliment I can give him is this:
I’m already trying to convince my son to train under him during his school vacations ❤️

Thank you, Veeraj Sir.
